rationale: The evidence file log/tab_ipw_mfg_byperiod.scsv (Table 2) reports the d_tradeusc~w (Chinese import exposure) 2SLS coefficients in columns 1-3 as -0.888, -0.718, and -0.746, with standard errors (0.181), (0.064), and (0.068) respectively (rows 5-6). These correspond to the paper values of -0.89 (1990-2000), -0.72 (2000-2007), and -0.75 (stacked 1990-2007). Each replicated value rounds exactly to the paper value and is well within 5% relative error (differences of 0.002, 0.002, 0.004). The N values (722, 722, 1444) and column structure also match the expected bivariate 2SLS specification without demographic controls.
